client_updates.highlight: Zeam: multi-client devnet stalled after ~8k slots; delayed aggregated signatures identified as root cause
Ream: aggregation time ~2s vs. Ethlambda's ~500ms; optimizing; integrating LeanVM main branch (not yet interop-tested)
Lantern: syncing issues fixed; LeanVM main branch cuts finality lag from double-digits to ~3 slots behind head
Ethlambda: 64-node devnet with latest LeanVM image shows time-to-finality <20–25 slots; 3% reorg rate remains
Gean: LeanVM signing/aggregation flow integrated on experimental branch; seeking agreed canonical LeanVM version
Grandine: optimization/metrics image released; testing updated LeanVM commit locally for ~3 days; official image planned this week

leanvm_and_research.highlight: LeanVM binary field branch (big extension field, small proofs) not yet on main; targeting 3× performance improvement
SSZ spec transferred to ethereum org (github.com/ethereum/ssz-specs); replaces lean spec copy as canonical reference
BNUS project underway: direct circuit interaction (no VM) to iterate proving system faster with binary fields expert
LeanVM main branch uses sub-MTU XMSS (smaller signatures, faster proving); clients must switch signing from lean-sig repo to LeanVM-internal implementation or compatibility will break
bump-arena allocator (setup-prover) improves speed but requires ~16 GB RAM; API low/high memory mode planned

organizational.highlight: No calls for the next two weeks; post-holiday cadence/format will be reorganized (more async debugging)

action_items.action: All client teams: migrate to LeanVM main branch XMSS signing (drop lean-sig repo); test single-client devnet first before multi-client interop
Add low/high memory mode toggle to LeanVM prover API for bump-arena allocator

decisions.decision: SSZ specification transferred from lean spec to official Ethereum org repo (ethereum/ssz-specs) as canonical reference

targets.target: Grandine official LeanVM-updated image release — this week
